title: Interpretability with the answer key: on a Tracr-compiled `reverse` circuit the linear probe has recall 1.00 and FPR 0.95 (it finds every variable at 18 of the 19 sites where the variable provably does not exist, and every false positive is an exact analytic inference), erasure recovers the true write->consume window and exposes 14/35 live cells that probe at 1.000 while costing 0.000 to delete - and the SAE, predicted to ACE the cleanest possible one-hot answer key, recovers 0/29 directions in ALL 30 SAEs while an independence control with the same 29 axes and the same firing rates scores 23/29, pinning the failure on feature DEPENDENCE, not density, dictionary size or superposition
hypothesis: On a Tracr-compiled transformer whose every residual dimension is a labelled variable by construction, (a) linear probes will recover each intermediate variable at the layer where it is constructed but will ALSO fire above chance at layers where the variable provably does not exist, because it is inferable from what is there - so probe accuracy localizes information, not computation; and (b) an L1 SAE on the residual stream should ACE the axis-aligned uncompressed basis (near-100% recovery, unlike the lab's 0.32 purity on the grokked model), while a compressed/superposed tracr model is the case where the SAE has to earn its keep.
question: With a network whose circuit is known by construction rather than inferred: (a) does a linear probe fire only where a variable actually lives, and if not, what exactly are the false positives made of; (b) does probe accuracy track causal use once the answer key tells you which sites are supposed to matter; (c) does an L1 SAE recover a residual basis that is axis-aligned, one-hot, non-negative and sparse - the friendliest ground truth available - and if not, is the cause the SAE, the dictionary, the density of the features, or the joint distribution of the code?
method: REAL TRACR, no hand-compiled fallback: `pip install tracr` fails (no such PyPI package) but `pip install "tracr @ git+https://github.com/google-deepmind/tracr.git"` installs and compiles on CPU in 5.6 s. The RASP program is rebuilt inline exactly as in tracr.compiler.lib so every intermediate SOp has a handle: length = SelectorWidth(TRUE) -> opp_idx = length - indices -> opp_idx-1 -> reverse = Aggregate(Select(indices, opp_idx-1, EQ), tokens). Compiled with vocab {a,b,c,d}, max_seq_len 6, BOS + PAD -> 4 layers, 1 head, key_size 14, d_mlp 42, d_model 49, NO LayerNorm, non-causal, 28,805 params, and every one of the 49 residual dims carries a label like `opp_idx_4:3` - that is the answer key. TWO-WAY VERIFICATION: (i) exact-sequence accuracy on the EXHAUSTIVE input set, all 1,364 sequences of length 1-5 over the 4-symbol vocab; (ii) the Haiku/JAX weights are ported to a hand-written torch forward (no LN, non-causal, ReLU MLP, 1/sqrt(key_size) scaling) and checked against JAX at all 9 residual sites on 40 inputs; (iii) the RASP program and each intermediate are evaluated symbolically and cross-checked. All probing/SAE work runs on the torch port. SITES (9): emb, then the residual after each attention and each MLP sublayer, L0.attn..L3.mlp. POSITIONS: all 6,372 non-BOS non-PAD positions. WHERE A VARIABLE LIVES (constructive key): its own one-hot block decodes it at accuracy 1.0 AND the block is genuinely one-hot at every position; this yields the birth chain tokens/indices@emb, length@L0.mlp, opp_idx@L1.mlp, opp_idx-1@L2.mlp, reverse@L3.attn. PROBES: multinomial logistic on the full 49-d residual at every site for every variable, split BY SEQUENCE (4,473 train / 1,899 test positions), Adam lr 0.1, 400 steps, wd 1e-4, each paired with a shuffled-label control; detection rule ported from 2026-07-25_dyck-probe-can-lie is test acc - majority >= 0.05, swept over {0.02,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4}. CAUSAL: zero the variable's OWN known dims at a site, run the rest of the model, measure exact-sequence accuracy, against 8 random rank-matched subspace projections (QR) at the same site; with the answer key we know which sites should matter. SAE: standard L1 ReLU dictionary (unit-norm decoder rows renormalised every step, dead-feature resampling at 40%/70%, Adam 3e-3, 1,500 steps, batch 512) on the final residual, activations scaled to E||x|| = sqrt(d). Answer key = the K=29 ALIVE residual axes (24 exact 0/1 indicators + 5 non-binary incl. the selector-width scalar); 20 dims are constant and excluded. Grid: expansion {1,2,4} x lambda {0.003,0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3} x 2 seeds = 30 SAEs. SCORING USES TWO INDEPENDENT GREEDY-INJECTIVE MATCHINGS (the duplicate trap from sae-on-merged-pairs): DIRECTION = signed cosine between key axis and unit decoder row, threshold 0.95, matched on the cosine matrix; BEHAVIOUR = best-F1 of the feature's firing pattern against the axis indicator (|corr| for non-binary axes), threshold 0.95, matched on the correlation matrix. Random-direction null over 20 draws. THREE ARMS BEYOND THE REAL CODE: (1) INDEPENDENCE CONTROL - the same 29 axes with the same marginal firing rates drawn INDEPENDENTLY, same SAE code and scoring, expansions {1,2}; (2) CONSTRUCTED SUPERPOSITION - the same code linearly projected to R^k (k=20, 14) by an orthonormal-row matrix so the K key directions provably cannot be mutually orthogonal, key = P e_j; (3) MODEL COMPRESSION as the backlog asked - residual moved to R^k with read = r@W, write = y@W^T, tracr weights FROZEN, W trained on output CE + layerwise MSE to the original residual stream, k in {32,24}. 30 + 10 + 30 SAEs, 2 compression runs, 54 probes x 2, 486 erasure forwards; 490.5 s total.
architecture: Tracr-compiled decoder-only transformer, 4 layers, 1 head, key_size 14, d_mlp 42, d_model 49, no LayerNorm, non-causal, 28,805 params, ported from Haiku/JAX to torch; plus L1 ReLU SAEs (49-196 dictionary features) and multinomial-logistic linear probes

dataset.name: exhaustive reverse-task inputs: all 1,364 sequences of length 1-5 over a 4-symbol vocab (6,372 non-BOS non-PAD positions)
dataset.source: generated in run.py; ground truth is the RASP program itself, evaluated symbolically

result_summary: THE PROBE LEG IS CONFIRMED HARDER THAN PREDICTED AND THE SAE LEG IS REFUTED. Tracr installs from github (not PyPI) and compiles `reverse` in 5.6 s into a 4-layer, 49-dim, 28,805-param transformer with no LayerNorm whose every residual dimension is a labelled variable; it is exactly correct on the EXHAUSTIVE input set (1.0000 over all 1,364 sequences) and the torch port matches JAX to 1.9e-06 at all 9 residual sites. The constructive answer key gives a clean four-layer birth chain: tokens/indices at emb, length at L0.mlp, opp_idx at L1.mlp, opp_idx-1 at L2.mlp, reverse at L3.attn. (1) PROBES ARE ALL RECALL AND NO PRECISION: 35/35 live cells detected, 18/19 NON-live cells also detected - FPR 0.947, localization accuracy 0.667, precision 0.660 - and no detection margin fixes it (margin 0.2 still leaves 11 FPs; margin 0.4 starts producing 7 FNs). Crucially every false positive is an exact, pre-statable inference rather than noise: `length` at L0.attn (0.991) is not an error at all because tracr's selector-width trick writes length in a NUMERICAL encoding one half-layer before the MLP one-hots it; `opp_idx`/`opp_idx-1` at emb score 0.787 against an analytic Bayes bound of 0.8035 for a predictor that sees only its own index; `opp_idx`/`opp_idx-1` hit 1.000 at L0.mlp and L1.attn because once one-hot length and one-hot indices are both present L-i is exactly linearly decodable by an additive logit, one to two layers before the model computes it; and the OUTPUT variable `reverse` probes at 0.3655 vs majority 0.2596 at all seven pre-birth sites, which is precisely the palindromic fixed points (probe 0.997-1.000 on the 17.14% of positions where opp_idx-1 == indices, 0.237 elsewhere, predicted 0.3768). So probe accuracy localizes INFORMATION, and the error is systematically in the early direction. (2) ERASURE RECOVERS THE TRUE CAUSAL WINDOW EXACTLY, AND 14 OF 35 LIVE CELLS ARE LIES: zeroing a variable's own dims is catastrophic exactly from where it is written to where it is consumed and a complete no-op afterwards (length destroys the model at L0.mlp/L1.attn -> 0.0147 but costs 0.000 at L1.mlp..L3.mlp where the probe still reads it at 1.000, and a RANDOM rank-7 erasure at L1.mlp costs 0.087); same for opp_idx (used only at L1.mlp/L2.attn), opp_idx-1 (used only at L2.mlp) and tokens (dead after L2.mlp). This is 2026-07-25_dyck-probe-can-lie reproduced with a provable rather than inferred answer key, and it shows the lie is generic: it is the state of every variable past its last consumer. (3) THE SAE DOES NOT ACE THE CLEAN CONSTRUCTED BASIS - 0/29 DIRECTIONS IN ALL 30 SAEs. On a basis that is axis-aligned, one-hot, non-negative, sparse (true L0 = 6.0 of 29) and reconstructed to FVU 2e-05, not one of 30 dictionaries (expansion 1/2/4 x lambda 0.003-0.3 x 2 seeds) contains a single direction at cosine >= 0.95 with a key axis; the best mean matched cosine is 0.592 and the naive max-cosine score is 0.593, so this is NOT the duplicate mirage of sae-on-merged-pairs - the directions genuinely are absent. The raw residual dimensions score 29/29 by construction, making this the third consecutive lab row where doing nothing beats the dictionary (0.75 vs 0.32 grokked; 8-vs-0 merged pairs; 29-vs-0 here). (4) THE INDEPENDENCE CONTROL IS THE DIAGNOSIS AND IT EXONERATES THE HARNESS: the same 29 axes with the same marginal firing rates (mean 0.207, mean L0 6.07) drawn INDEPENDENTLY score 23/29 directional and 27/29 behavioural at mean matched cosine 0.899. Nothing changed but the joint distribution, so the failure is not dictionary size, not the L1 coefficient, not feature density and not superposition - the projected/superposed arms (orthonormal-row projection to k=20 and k=14, 1.45x and 2.07x, key mean |cos| 0.14 and 0.19) score 0/29 too, i.e. no worse than the unprojected code. The cause is the DEPENDENCE built into any tracr code: variables are one-hot blocks (perfect within-block mutual exclusion), blocks are linked by exact arithmetic (opp_idx-1_3:j is identical to opp_idx_4:j+1 at |corr| 1.000, so 5 of the 29 axes are exact duplicates that no behavioural method can ever separate), and every position lights exactly 6 axes in one of a few hundred fixed combinations. An L1 dictionary then prefers one feature per STATE to one per VARIABLE, and the signature is in the number: 0.49-0.59 is about 1/sqrt(4), what you get bundling ~4 unit axes into one direction. The honest silver lining is behavioural: 21/29 axes do have a feature that fires almost exactly when they do, so the SAE finds the right EVENTS and refuses to put them on the right AXES. (5) AN HONEST NEGATIVE ON THE BACKLOG'S PREFERRED ARM: training a read/write matrix with tracr weights frozen never yields an exact compressed model - k=32 and k=24 both plateau at 0.7713 exact-sequence accuracy (also at 3000 steps, with a cosine schedule, and at MSE weight 0.1), so the superposed case was built in activation space instead and is labelled as such throughout. CAVEATS: one program (reverse) and one activation site (final residual); the SAE grid is L1-only, so 0/29 may be specific to the L1 prior rather than to sparse dictionaries in general; the answer key's 5 exact duplicate pairs cap any behavioural score at 24 distinguishable axes; the probe false-positive analysis is exact for this program but its magnitudes (e.g. 0.787 from the length marginal) depend on the length distribution of the exhaustive input set.

novelty_check.conclusion: PARTIAL-PRIOR-ART. The IDEA is explicitly prior art: the Tracr paper (2301.05062) states that 'the known structure of Tracr-compiled models can serve as ground-truth for evaluating interpretability methods' and ships the compressed-model code, and InterpBench (2407.14494) builds 85 Tracr-derived semi-synthetic transformers for exactly this purpose - but a direct fetch confirms InterpBench evaluates CIRCUIT-DISCOVERY methods (ACDC, Subnetwork Probing, EAP, EAP-IG) and explicitly does not evaluate probes or SAEs. Ground-truth SAE evaluations exist (SAGE 2410.07456, SynthSAEBench 2602.14687) but run on real LMs and synthetic feature generators, not on Tracr. WHAT THIS ROW ADDS: (a) a LAYER-RESOLVED probe localization score (TP/FP/FN/TN over variable x site) against the constructive answer key, with all 18 false positives explained analytically - a Bayes bound for the marginal leak, an additive-logit identity for L-i, a fixed-point rate for the output variable, and an alternative numerical encoding the strict one-hot key mis-scores - rather than reported as noise; (b) per-variable CAUSAL WINDOWS from own-dims erasure against 8 rank-matched random projections, which recover the write->consume interval exactly and expose 14 of 35 live cells where a 1.000-accurate probe reads a variable the model no longer uses; (c) the SAE DIRECTION-vs-BEHAVIOUR decomposition on a constructed basis with an INDEPENDENCE CONTROL that moves the score from 0/29 to 23/29 with nothing changed but the joint distribution, which is the piece that turns 'the SAE failed' into 'the SAE fails on DEPENDENT features, and Tracr codes are maximally dependent by construction' - a direct warning for anyone validating an SAE on Tracr. The 'no published version of this specific evaluation' claim is a negative search result over 5 web searches and 2 direct fetches, not an exhaustive review; arXiv/OpenAlex APIs 403 from this environment.
